recommendation: Support increasing equity allocation CONDITIONALLY — only IF liquidity remains above 5% of portfolio value AND retirement projections stay above 90% probability after the allocation change. Current cash reserves of 8% provide adequate buffer for near-term flexibility.
rationale: Cash reserves at 8% meet the 5% liquidity threshold with 3% buffer. Retirement roadmap projects on-track at 93% probability. Income projections support additional equity exposure. However, both liquidity and retirement adequacy must be re-verified after allocation change — the 3% buffer is narrow and retirement sensitivity to equity market moves is not independently validated.
evidence_summary: Cash reserves 8% (>5% threshold). Income yield at 2.3%. Retirement on-track at 93% probability. Liquidity adequate with 3% buffer. Retirement projections partially evidenced — not independently validated.

material_risks.description: Liquidity buffer of 3% is narrow — market drawdown could push below 5% threshold
Retirement projections not independently validated — actual probability may be lower than 93%

alternatives_considered: Maintain current allocation until retirement projections are independently verified
Reduce equity increase to 2% to preserve a wider liquidity buffer
Full 3% equity increase — accepted with explicit conditions on liquidity and retirement

conditions_to_change_view.condition: Liquidity drops below 5% of portfolio value after allocation change
conditions_to_change_view.rationale: Liquidity below threshold compromises near-term flexibility and emergency reserves

conditions_to_change_view.condition: Retirement projections fall below 90% probability after equity market sensitivity analysis
conditions_to_change_view.rationale: Retirement adequacy must take priority over equity growth

evidence_gaps: Retirement projections not independently validated — policy projections only
deficiencies_acknowledged: Retirement projections are policy projections, not independently validated by a third-party tool
Conditional support requires operator to verify both conditions are met before executing
